purpose: Market/developer use-case map with scope classification. Evidence-based; Platrixa is the semantic-validation layer underneath these products, not the products.

scope_levels.CORE: Platrixa could sit underneath with today's architecture
scope_levels.ADJACENT: needs nearby infrastructure Platrixa should partner with, not build
scope_levels.FUTURE: requires new infrastructure before Platrixa can serve it

core_hypothesis_verdict.hypothesis: Platrixa is financial semantic validation infrastructure for developers building AI-powered accounting and finance software
core_hypothesis_verdict.narrowing: initial beachhead is event-level semantic interpretation of transactional text (narrations, descriptions, document text) with deterministic executability - NOT document-layout extraction (OCR vendors own it) and NOT multi-document matching engines (workflow products own it). Row-level document text is in; document graphs are future infrastructure.
core_hypothesis_verdict.evidence: strongest current capability (payment/receipt narrations, 852-check refusal discipline, kernel journal round-trip) aligns exactly with the highest-frequency developer problem (bank-feed categorization + AI bookkeeping posting)
